nesCheats.invalidCode: Use a valid NES code, with up to 32 enabled at once.
nesCheats.title: NES cheats
nesCheats.scope: Rules apply to the running cartridge. Use Save progress to keep the game state. Stopping the game clears active rules.
nesCheats.name: Label (optional)
nesCheats.formats: Enter one 6- or 8-letter Game Genie code, or a hexadecimal address and value such as 00FE:09. A code can override what the game reads while the stored byte stays the same.
nesCheats.limit: Keep at most 32 rules in this session.
nesCheats.overlap: Disable the other active rule for this address first.
nesCheats.applyFailed: The emulator could not apply these rules.
